|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. While in battle, just after drawing battle destiny, may lose X cards from hand to add X to attrition against opponent.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. During the power segment of a battle here, may lose X cards from hand to cause +X attrition against opponent. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' “Immune to attrition < 4. While in battle, just after drawing” → “During the power segment of a”; “destiny,” → “here,”; “add X to” → “cause +X”; added “Immune to attrition < 4.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 29. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195348/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Blizzard 1]].
* Later text: [[Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
